fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The vendor this account speaks to. The channel is `voice`; the provider names which adapter carries it, so the doctype stays vendor-neutral.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: A voice send resolves this account only when it is enabled. Off, a routed lead takes the send's `failed` edge — never a call through a disabled account.

fields.label: Provider Credentials (outbound — the CRM calls the provider)
API Key
fields.description: Provider API key. Read server-side only (Password field) — never shipped to the client.

fields.label: From Number (optional)
fields.description: The caller-id number the provider dials from, in full international form starting with the country code (for example +919876543210). Optional; a per-call override wins over this, this wins over the agent default.

fields.label: Inbound Webhook (the provider calls the CRM)
Webhook Token
fields.description: Generate one, save, then register the URL from 'Copy Webhook URLs' on the provider's agent. It proves the caller is the provider and tells the CRM which account the call arrived on. Blank means inbound is off — a placed call then has nothing to report its outcome back through.

fields.label: Previous Webhook Token
fields.description: Set during a rotation; both tokens authenticate until this one is cleared, so no call outcome is rejected mid-rotation.

fields.label: Token Digest
fields.description: Derived, never entered. A Password field cannot be indexed, so this digest is what makes authentication one read rather than a scan and decrypt of every account.

fields.label: Authentication
fields.description: The token is always enforced. HMAC is added only for a provider that signs its payloads, which Bolna does not.

fields.label: HMAC Signing Secret
fields.description: The shared secret the provider signs its payloads with.

fields.label: Signature Header
fields.description: The header carrying the provider's signature, e.g. X-Signature.

fields.label: Signature Algorithm
fields.description: The hash the provider signs with.

fields.label: Signature Encoding
fields.description: How the provider encodes the signature it sends.

fields.label: Signature Prefix
fields.description: Stripped before comparison, e.g. 'sha256='. Left blank when the provider sends a bare signature.

fields.label: Enforce IP Allowlist
fields.description: Rejects any inbound call outcome that does not come from an address listed below. Leave it off unless the provider publishes fixed addresses — a wrong list silently drops every outcome. It cannot be turned on while the list is empty.

fields.label: Allowed Addresses
fields.description: One IP address or CIDR range per line, e.g. 13.234.10.5 or 13.234.0.0/16. Anything after a # is ignored. Read only when Enforce IP Allowlist is ticked.
